function_signature: def pfa_recover_aes_last_round_key(corrupted_sbox_value: int, ciphertexts: list[bytes], byte_idx: int) -> int
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (13 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: Brute-force decryption for verification is not allowed (a statistical method is required)
in the frequency count, if several byte values tie for the lowest, take the smallest byte value
an empty list or an element that is not 16 bytes raises ValueError
corrupted_sbox_value/byte_idx out of range raises ValueError
no statistics library other than scipy/numpy may be used
source: Zhang-Lou-Zhao *Persistent Fault Analysis on Block Ciphers*, CHES 2018; 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.11 §5
author: Zhou Wenquan
